# WebScraping.AI

> > WebScraping.AI is a web scraping API service that handles proxies, CAPTCHA solving, and AI-powered data extraction with support for JavaScript rendering using Chromium/Chrome.

The service provides a comprehensive API for developers working with Python, JavaScript/Node.js, PHP, Ruby, and other languages. It offers tools like Beautiful Soup integration, proxy rotation, and browser automation with Puppeteer, Playwright, and Selenium support.

## Key Topics

- Web Scraping API
- Proxy Rotation
- CAPTCHA Solving
- JavaScript Rendering
- Beautiful Soup
- Puppeteer & Playwright
- Python Data Extraction
- API Rate Limiting
- HTML Parsing
- Chromium Browser Automation
- Residential & Datacenter Proxies
- API Authentication
- Retry Logic
- Node.js Scraping Libraries
- lxml Parser
